title: Open Door
scenario: A local administration service is listening on all interfaces. AI-assisted enumeration suggests several possible exposures.
objective: Restrict the admin service to local access and prove which exposure was real.
ai_native_dimension: AI helps form enumeration hypotheses; the learner must validate the binding and make the smallest correction.
aar_questions: What was the security problem in Open Door and what objective evidence proved it?
What was the risk if it remained unresolved?
What did you change and why?
How did you verify the result independently of AI output?
Where did AI help, where was it wrong/incomplete, and what remained your responsibility?
